# IndusAGI

> IndusAGI is an open-source developer framework and terminal-first AI coding agent documented for TypeScript, Python, and Rust.

## Start here
- Website: https://www.indusagi.com/
- TypeScript framework documentation: https://www.indusagi.com/docs/getting-started
- TypeScript coding agent documentation: https://www.indusagi.com/cli/README
- TypeScript coding agent package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/indusagi-coding-agent

Install the TypeScript coding agent, which provides the `indus` and `indusagi` commands:

```bash
npm install -g indusagi-coding-agent
```

The npm package requires Node.js 20 or newer.
Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/indusagi-coding-agent/latest

## Documentation families
- TypeScript framework: https://www.indusagi.com/docs/getting-started
- TypeScript coding agent: https://www.indusagi.com/cli/README
- Python framework: https://www.indusagi.com/python/getting-started
- Python coding agent: https://www.indusagi.com/python-cli/getting-started
- Rust framework: https://www.indusagi.com/rust/getting-started
- Rust coding agent: https://www.indusagi.com/rust-cli/getting-started
